subject.title: boot-md hook re-runs BOOT.md on every gateway restart

question: Should boot-md keep the documented per-gateway-startup BOOT.md contract, or change to a run-once per workspace/config-generation lifecycle with an explicit reset path?
rationale: Current code and docs intentionally describe per-startup execution, while the issue and production datapoint show credible session/channel harm from repeated restarts; automation should not choose the lifecycle or state owner without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt canonical run-once lifecycle
options.body: Store completion in canonical OpenClaw state, provide an explicit reset/doctor path, and update docs/tests so restarts do not rerun BOOT.md by default.

options.title: Keep per-startup behavior
options.body: Document the current behavior as intentional and close this direction, possibly adding stronger warnings for long-running or heavy BOOT.md tasks.

options.title: Add an explicit mode
options.body: Keep the compatibility default and add a reviewed opt-in run-once mode only if maintainers accept the added configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt canonical run-once lifecycle
recommendation.body: Store completion in canonical OpenClaw state, provide an explicit reset/doctor path, and update docs/tests so restarts do not rerun BOOT.md by default.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product/docs lifecycle choice, and steipete both merged the original boot-md PR and authored the current documentation that states the per-startup contract.
